local_first.title: 1. No Servers (Local-First)
local_first.p1: Cuánto llevo gastao is designed with a Local-First philosophy. This means we have no central servers, cloud databases, or systems to collect, store, or process your data.
local_first.p2: All information entered into the application is stored exclusively on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) using browser technologies (IndexedDB).

responsibility.title: 2. User Responsibility and Security
responsibility.p1: Since we do not have access to your data, we cannot recover it in case of loss, device theft, or accidental browser deletion.
responsibility.p2: Therefore, it is your sole responsibility to:
responsibility.li1: Maintain the physical and logical security of your device.
responsibility.li3: Use the encryption option when exporting backups to protect sensitive data if sharing the file.

stored_data.title: 3. Stored Data
stored_data.p1: The application locally stores the following information necessary for its operation:
stored_data.li2: Purchases record, item breakdowns, and scanned receipts.
stored_data.li4: Access tokens or user-configured keys (if applicable).

third_party.title: 4. Third-Party Services
third_party.p1: Although Cuánto llevo gastao has no servers of its own, the application may connect directly from your browser to third-party services if you enable these features:

google_calendar.title: Google Calendar API
google_calendar.description: Only used if you connect your calendar to read events. The connection is made directly between your browser and Google.

google_maps.title: Google Maps API
google_maps.description: If you configure your API key, it will be used to calculate distances or locations.

deletion.title: 5. Data Deletion
deletion.p1: You have full control over your data. You can delete all information stored by Cuánto llevo gastao at any time simply by:
deletion.li1: Using the "Delete all data" option in the maintenance section of Settings.
deletion.li2: Or by clearing website data (cookies and local storage) in your browser settings.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.p1: If you have questions about this policy or the technical operation of the application, you can open an issue or discussion on the official GitHub repository.

nature.title: 1. Nature of Service
nature.p1: Cuánto llevo gastao is a free and open-source software project (GitHub) developed and distributed entirely free of charge and non-profit.
nature.p2: The purpose of this software is to provide a helpful tool for smart tracking of supermarket purchases and expenses, but does not constitute a professional or commercial service.

beta.title: 2. Development Status (Beta)
beta.p1: This application is currently in BETA and is considered a "proof of concept". This means the software is still under active development, may contain bugs, incomplete features, or undergo significant changes without prior notice.

disclaimer.title: 3. Disclaimer of Warranties and Liability
disclaimer.p1: The software is provided "AS IS" ("AS IS"), without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement.
disclaimer.p2: In no event shall the authors or copyright holders be liable for any claim, damages, or other liability, whether in an action of contract, tort, or otherwise, arising from, out of, or in connection with the software or the use or other dealings in the software.
disclaimer.warning: Important: The user is solely responsible for the accuracy of entered data and for performing periodic backups. Cuánto llevo gastao saves no data on its servers and is not responsible for any loss of data stored locally on the user's device.

privacy.title: 4. Privacy and Data
privacy.p1: Cuánto llevo gastao operates under a Local-First philosophy. All data you enter (purchases, receipts, budget, personal details) is stored exclusively in your browser (IndexedDB).
privacy.p2: No information is sent to third-party servers, with the exception of:
privacy.li1: The OpenAI API if you choose to use smart receipt extraction with AI (direct communication between your browser and OpenAI).
privacy.li2: The Google Maps API if you configure your key for supermarket location autocomplete.

license.title: 5. License
license.p1: This project is licensed under the terms of the MIT license. You are free to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the software, provided that the copyright notice and original permission notice are included.
